notes.title: Bigfoot Hunters Update
notes.notes:
Hey there, Bigfoot enthusiasts! I’ve got some exciting updates and important fixes to enhance your hunting experience. Check out what’s new:

[b]Framerate Fixes:[/b]
No more stuttering! I’ve optimized performance, and the game should now run smoothly without needing a super computer.

[b]Automatic Battery Swapping:[/b]
Changing out batteries is now seamless! No more fiddling or glitching when replacing them. Your flashlight will swap batteries automatically, keeping you focused on the hunt.

[b]Tree Knocking Made Easy:[/b]
Tree knocking has been simplified! Just grab a stick and smack it against any tree. Keep your ears sharp—Bigfoot might knock back. Are you ready to answer?

[b]Stay Alert for Clues:[/b]
Bigfoot’s trail isn’t just on the ground—look high, low, and everywhere in between. Keep your eyes peeled for subtle signs from the earth, deep in the forest ahead, or even the sky that could lead you closer to the legendary creature.

[b]Trailcams Are Here![/b]
I’ve added trailcams to your hunting toolkit! Now, you can set up cameras and monitor the wilderness like a true cryptid tracker. Press "X" to drop a trailcam at your current location. Use them wisely to cover key areas and catch any movement Bigfoot might make when you’re not around. For now, you’ll begin with the maximum number of trailcams, so you can dive right into the action. But keep an eye out—future updates will require you to search for and collect trailcams throughout the forest.

[b]Viewing Your Captures:[/b]
Press "J" to open your Trailcam Photo Book, and you can check photos taken by your cams. Any movement they capture could be the clue you need to track Bigfoot's path. 

Good luck out there, hunters. Remember: Bigfoot is out there somewhere... will you be the one to find him?

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Big Tree Knockers Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZRvaj06.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

I am thrilled to announce that another update has arrived for Search 4 Bigfoot! This update brings with it a host of enhancements and new features that I can't wait for you to explore.

First and foremost, you'll immediately notice the improved graphics. The forests are more vivid, the landscapes are more immersive, and the overall visual experience is more lifelike than ever. I've worked hard to make sure your hunt for Bigfoot is as realistic as possible.

Additionally, there are more pieces of evidence scattered throughout the game for you to discover. These new clues will challenge your tracking skills and bring you closer to uncovering the mysteries of the elusive Bigfoot.

I'm also introducing some exciting new items to aid you in your quest. Get ready for thermal vision and trailcams, which will give you an edge in tracking down your target. Plus, I've added sticks for tree knocking – a classic technique used in Bigfoot hunting.

However, please note that some of these new items are still in the final stages of testing and might not fully work as expected. I plan to go over these items in more detail at a later date, as I fine-tune them for your hunting experience.

Lastly, while you're out there, immersed in your hunt, don't forget to occasionally cast your gaze skyward. The night sky holds its own secrets.

Happy hunting, and remember, the truth is out there, waiting to be discovered!

notes.title: The Big Stomp Update
notes.notes:
Prepare to embark on an even more thrilling and immersive adventure in the search for the elusive Bigfoot with the Big Stomp Update! This update takes the heart-pounding excitement of hunting the legendary creature to a whole new level, offering players a vastly improved gaming experience with exciting new features and enhanced graphics.

1. Lush and Detailed Forest Upgrade:
The Big Stomp Update introduces a visually stunning overhaul of the forest environment. You'll find yourself immersed in a dense, lush forest teeming with life, with a more realistic and immersive atmosphere, making your nocturnal hunt for Bigfoot feel even more gripping.

2. Semi-realistic Wildlife Encounters:
The forest comes alive with a variety of new wildlife species. These animals add realism and complexity to the environment, providing new challenges and opportunities for your Bigfoot expedition. Excuse some of their janky movements, as they are still in an early state.

3. Advanced Radar System:
Navigate through the forest more effectively with the upgraded radar system. This new tool helps you track the movements of animals and Bigfoot more accurately, providing valuable information to plan your strategy.

4. Trail Cameras:
You now can set up trail cameras to capture evidence of Bigfoot's presence. For now, each camera will add power to the radar, but soon they will capture digital images of Bigfoot in the wild, guiding your search.

5. Photographs as Evidence:
Incorporate photography into your hunt for Bigfoot. Capture blurry yet compelling images of the forest, wildlife, and potential Bigfoot sightings. Coming soon you will it will be possible to collect and analyze your photographs to uncover hidden secrets.

6. Thermal Vision Technology:
Equip yourself with state-of-the-art thermal vision goggles. Detect the warmth of nearby creatures, and follow mysterious heat signatures to get closer to the legendary beast.

7. Special Vision Setting - Bigfoot Glimpse:
One of the most thrilling additions to the Big Stomp Update is the Special Vision Setting. When you're close to Bigfoot, activate this feature for a brief but exhilarating glimpse of the elusive creature.

Are you ready to venture deeper into the heart of the forest and uncover the truth about Bigfoot? With the Big Stomp Update, you'll experience the ultimate thrill of the hunt like never before. Explore the new, stunningly detailed forest, utilize advanced tools, and get ready for spine-tingling encounters in your quest to capture definitive proof of Bigfoot's existence. 

Remember, you have to find the evidence to find Bigfoot.

Coming soon: 
-Co-op mode

notes.title: Update 4 Bigfeets
notes.notes:
-New biome to find and search
-New items to find
-Two new random events
-More sounds
-Fixed glowsticks spawning too much
-Adjusted flashlight burnout
-Adjusted random events

Having a hard time finding Bigfoot? Don't worry, we all are. Remember to pay attention to the forest around you. The sounds of nature are clues to help you along your way. Always watch the trees and scan the ground, because you never know what evidence you might find. He's out there!
